title: The Hunter's Moon
text: The moon rises red and full over the hills, so close and so bright that every blade of grass casts a shadow. Somewhere a beast is howling. The old hunters say the quarry cannot hide tonight. They also say nothing else can.

options.label: Hunt by the red moonlight, while the quarry cannot hide.

outcomes.text: There it is, black against the red. It cannot hide tonight, and neither can you.

options.label: Rest, and hunt at dawn. Nothing else can hide tonight either.

outcomes.text: In the night it moves close by. You hear it pass the camp slowly, then go on; nobody breathes until it is gone.

options.label: The devout asks the red moon for luck, as hunters have for ages.

outcomes.text: The moon answers. The shadows lean your way.
